name: io.github.khaoss85/agent-crm
description: Project context and narrow write tools for an agent-native CRM framework: inspect the project, list opportunities, request a stage change, decide an approval, read a workflow trace, scaffold a module. Code-generating tools are dry-run unless apply is explicitly true.
